evidence.observation: Reflux flow declining steadily from 0.85 to ~0.67 L/h, with a momentary dropout to 0.004 at k=15
Distillate flow decayed from ~0.10 to 0.01-0.03 L/h
Spike to 5.73 mbar (from ~2) then 3.24, coincident with PY23 dip to 396 mbar
Dropped to 0.029 mbar, below prior 0.22-0.43 band

args.missing_evidence: Column temperature profile (none installed) and a composition/GC sample; also whether the PDI702 spike persists — a rising differential pressure with falling throughput suggests flooding or partial exhaust/vapor-path blockage.
